Description: The Engineering department builds and operates every NovaCorp product platform, covering backend services, frontend web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure and site reliability. Teams work in two-week sprints, own their services end to end from design through production support, and follow a trunk-based development model with automated CI/CD. Engineering runs a structured mentoring programme and every new joiner is paired with a buddy for their first ninety days.

The Data and Analytics department owns the NovaCorp data platform, from ingestion pipelines and the lakehouse through to business intelligence, experimentation and machine learning. The team supports product, finance and operations with self-service reporting, maintains data quality and governance standards, and partners with Engineering on event instrumentation. Analysts and data engineers sit together in pods aligned to business domains.

The Product department defines what NovaCorp builds and why. Product managers own discovery, roadmap and outcomes for their area, working daily with Engineering, Design and Data. The team runs continuous customer research, quarterly planning against measurable outcomes rather than feature lists, and a monthly product review with the leadership group. Product also houses technical writing and product operations.

The Design department covers product design, user research, design systems and brand. Designers are embedded in product squads while contributing to the shared NovaCorp design system, which is used across web and mobile. The research team runs weekly usability sessions and maintains a customer insight repository open to everyone in the company. Accessibility is a standing requirement in every design review.

The Sales and Marketing department drives NovaCorp revenue across enterprise and mid-market segments in India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. It includes field sales, inside sales, solution consulting, partner alliances, demand generation, content and product marketing. The team works on a shared pipeline model with quarterly targets and a structured enablement programme for every new seller.

The People and Culture department covers talent acquisition, learning and development, total rewards, employee relations and workplace experience across all eight NovaCorp offices. Talent Acquisition Manager Aisha Nair leads recruitment for the company and is the owner of the Zava TalentHub initiative. The department also runs the NovaCorp learning stipend, the internal mobility programme and the quarterly engagement survey.
